test: add manual network-isolation smoke workflow (#5492)

Minimal workflow_dispatch test exercising the experimental AWF
network-isolation topology (sandbox.agent.network-isolation: true) with
firewall and gateway/mcpg images pinned to latest. Two curl egress checks:
allowed github.com should succeed, non-allowed example.com should be blocked.

Adds the v0.81.2 gh-aw-actions/setup pin to actions-lock.json (kept alongside
the v0.81.0 entries used by other locks) since network-isolation requires
gh aw v0.81.2+.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
commits.attribution_evidence: no supported agent signature in commit metadata

md_changes.file_patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+---
+description: Network Isolation Test - Minimal manual smoke test for the experimental AWF network-isolation topology
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+engine:
+  id: copilot
+  model: claude-haiku-4-5
+network:
+  allowed:
+    - defaults
+    - github
+tools:
+  bash:
+    - "*"
+sandbox:
+  mcp:
+    version: "latest"
+  agent:
+    network-isolation: true
+    version: "latest"
+strict: false
+max-turns: 5
+timeout-minutes: 10
+---
+
+# Network Isolation Test
+
+This is a minimal, manually-triggered smoke test for the **experimental AWF
+network-isolation topology** (`sandbox.agent.network-isolation: true`). It
+confirms the Docker-network egress model still enforces the domain allowlist.
+
+Run the two checks below and report the results in your final message.
+
+## 1. Allowed domain is reachable
+
+`github.com` is on the allowlist, so this request should succeed:
+
+```bash
+curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "allowed=%{http_code}\n" https://api.github.com/zen
+```
+
+## 2. Non-allowed domain is blocked
+
+`example.com` is **not** on the allowlist, so this request should fail
+(non-zero exit / connection error / proxy denial):
+
+```bash
+curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "denied=%{http_code}\n" https://example.com && \
+  echo "UNEXPECTED: example.com was reachable" || \
+  echo "OK: example.com was blocked"
+```
+
+## Report
+
+Summarize whether network isolation is enforcing the egress allowlist as
+expected: the allowed domain should return an HTTP status code, and the
+non-allowed domain should be blocked.

commits.message:
fix: pin network-isolation-test to concrete release tags (#5495)

* fix: pin network-isolation-test to concrete release tags

The workflow pinned firewall and mcpg to "latest", but install_awf_binary.sh
treats the version as a literal release tag and builds
releases/download/latest/checksums.txt, which 404s (there is no GitHub release
tagged "latest"). The run failed at the Install AWF binary step with curl exit
code 22.

Pin to concrete latest tags instead: firewall v0.27.10 and mcpg v0.3.30. The
binary download and all GHCR image tags (agent/api-proxy/squid 0.27.10,
gh-aw-mcpg v0.3.30) were verified to resolve.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix: raise network-isolation-test turn budget to avoid hard-cap 403

Run 28112808921 failed: the Copilot api-proxy returned a non-retryable 403
on the agent's LLM call. Root cause was the maxRuns hard cap (derived from
max-turns) — api-proxy guards return 403 once AWF_MAX_RUNS is exceeded
(containers/api-proxy/guards/common-guard-checks.js:84). With max-turns: 5 the
agent exhausted its budget inspecting awf (which/--version/--help) before
finishing the two curl egress checks.

Raise max-turns 5 -> 15 (maxRuns 15) and instruct the agent to run the two
curl commands directly without introspecting the awf binary.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* test: drop sudo from network-isolation lock (keep artifact-upload only)

Manual lock edit to validate rootless network-isolation: removes sudo from
the awf binary install (tee/chmod) and the awf invocation, keeping only the
artifact-upload chmod. Note: regenerated by gh aw compile / postprocess.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* chore: recompile network-isolation-test lock with gh-aw main (rootless)

Recompiled with `gh-aw compile --gh-aw-ref main`, producing a fully
rootless lock: install_awf_binary.sh v0.27.10 --rootless (no sudo),
digest-pinned container images, and gh-aw-main setup action.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* chore: pin setup action to gh-aw rootless-install fix

Recompile against gh-aw branch fix/rootless-awf-install-user-prefix
(c2d22aa3ac) so the rootless install writes awf to a user-writable
$HOME/.local prefix and exports it to $GITHUB_PATH, fixing the
"--rootless requires write access to /usr/local/lib/awf" failure on
standard ubuntu-latest runners.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix: exclude network-isolation-test from postprocess (release-mode)

The network-isolation smoke test intentionally exercises the PUBLISHED awf
binary (rootless bundle install) and pinned GHCR container images. Postprocess
was rewriting --skip-pull -> --build-local, which the standalone awf bundle
rejects ("--build-local requires a full repository checkout"). Add a
release-mode exclusion set so this lock keeps the raw compiled output:
rootless install + --skip-pull with pre-downloaded pinned images.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* ci: recompile network-isolation-test against gh-aw main

Rename frontmatter sandbox.agent.network-isolation to sudo:false (gh-aw
renamed the property; sudo:false enables the --network-isolation topology).
Setup action now pins gh-aw main HEAD 919d05cc, which includes the merged
rootless install fix (#41310). Lock retains --rootless --skip-pull, pinned
released images, 0 sudo.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* ci: add build-test-network-isolation smoke workflow

Network-isolation variant of the build-test matrix: sudo:false topology,
latest released firewall (0.27.10) and mcpg (v0.3.30) container images, no
local builds (--rootless --skip-pull). Setup action pinned to gh-aw main
(919d05cc, includes rootless install fix #41310). Added the lock to
releaseModeLockFiles so postprocess keeps the released bundle/images
instead of rewriting to --build-local.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

ci: add required supply-chain scan on every PR (#6530)

* ci: add required supply-chain scan on every PR

Add a deterministic (non-agentic) workflow that runs
`gh aw compile --strict --syft --grype --grant` on every pull request.

The Anchore scanners run via Docker against the container images recorded
in the compiled `*.lock.yml` manifests:
- --syft:  generate an SBOM per image
- --grype: scan for known CVEs / insecure libraries
- --grant: enforce the license allowlist in `.grant.yaml`

`--strict` makes any finding or scan error fail the job so it acts as a
real gate. Add `.grant.yaml` at the repo root since `--grant` requires it.

The "Compile + Syft/Grype/Grant" check is added to the "CI passes before
merging to main" ruleset so it is required before merge.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
Copilot-Session: 92b2407f-7d59-464d-afe7-bc21bd71bddb

* ci: address PR review feedback on supply-chain-scan workflow and grant policy

- Fix .grant.yaml: derive allowlist from actual syft scans of squid/agent/api-proxy
  images; set require-known-license: false for Ubuntu's non-SPDX license strings
- Fix workflow line 16: correct required-check context name to
  'Supply Chain Scan / Compile + Syft/Grype/Grant'
- Fix workflow line 38: update actions/checkout to v7.0.1 SHA
  (3d3c42e5) matching the rest of the repo (was v6.0.2 SHA mislabelled as v4)
- Fix workflow line 50: remove mutable --grype/--grant flags from gh aw compile;
  replace with explicit Docker steps pinned to reviewed digests:
  grype v0.116.0 (sha256:fd4ab4d1) and grant v0.6.8 (sha256:17246361)
  with GHCR auth via docker login + packages: read permission

* ci: don't fail supply-chain scan on strict mode; use local awf builds

The supply-chain-scan compile step used `gh aw compile --strict`, which
forced repo-wide strict validation and rejected 24 workflows that pin
`sandbox.mcp.version` (an internal implementation detail disallowed in
strict mode). The Syft/Grype/Grant scanners don't require strict, so drop
the flag: `gh aw compile --syft`.

Separately, make the smoke/build-test workflows build awf/firewall from
the repo's own source and use the compiler-default MCP gateway image:

- Remove `sandbox.mcp.version` and `sandbox.agent.version` pins from 22
  workflow .md files. Without the mcp pin the compiler uses its default
  gateway (v0.4.3) instead of the stale pinned v0.3.x.
- Empty the postprocess release-mode exclusion set so the
  network-isolation variants also build locally (--build-local); the
  injected full-repo checkout makes that valid everywhere.
- Update the now-inaccurate "no local builds" note in
  build-test-network-isolation.md.

Recompiled all lock files and re-ran postprocess-smoke-workflows.ts.

ci: use github.token for copilot-engine workflows (drop removed COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN secret) (#6556)

* ci: add copilot-requests perm, use github.token for copilot engine

The COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN secret was removed from the repo, causing every
copilot-engine workflow that referenced secrets.COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN to
send an empty token to the api-proxy and get HTTP 401 from
api.githubcopilot.com. Adding the copilot-requests: write permission lets
gh-aw compile the built-in github.token as COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN instead,
removing the dependency on the deleted secret.

* ci: fix BYOK copilot token source
